India's First Bullet Train: Plan Includes Delhi to Agra in 1 Hour, Lucknow in 2 Hours | GRAVITAS
In a recent major travel update, India Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the Northern Corridor of India's bullet train network. When completed, the journey from Delhi to Agra could only take just 59 minutes, while reaching Lucknow may take a little over two hours. The news was announced by Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw on October 31, 2026.
